description: Synthetic service inventory for CloudSentinel — ownership tags and a change log for the services that appear in mock_costs.json and mock_security_events.json. Same synthetic estate, same period, so the enrichment can answer 'who owns this' and 'did anything ship' next to a signal without inventing an answer at request time. The change log deliberately contains all four cases: a deployment on the compute spike (2026-06-29), a deployment the day before the borderline network blip (2026-06-30), nothing at all near the database spike (2026-07-02), and a storage deployment that coincides with no signal — so 'a deploy explains it' is a finding, not a foregone conclusion. Release refs are opaque on purpose: SENTINEL_REBASE_DATES shifts these dates along with the cost data, and a date-shaped ref would then contradict the day it shipped on.
